create_dataflow_graph: create a dataflow_graph.Graph instance to build a computational graph with nodes and edges
add_node_to_graph: add a named node with an optional size attribute to the dataflow graph
add_edge_to_graph: add a named edge between source and destination nodes with an optional size
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize the dataflow graph to normalize its internal representation
build_two_weight_graph: build a dataflow graph with two weight nodes connected through operator nodes
